items.title: Award-Winning Architecture
items.description: Architecture that earns recognition through craft, restraint, and a clear idea of place.

items.title: Influential and Impactful
items.description: Urban design draws together the many strands of place-making, environmental stewardship, social equity and economic viability into the creation of places with distinct beauty and identity.

items.title: Functional Interior Design
items.description: Interiors planned around how people move, work, and linger — useful first, then memorable.

items.title: Award-Winning Architecture
items.description: Towers and civic rooms that hold their own against climate, traffic, and time.

items.title: City Marks
items.description: Landmarks that give a skyline a readable silhouette without shouting.

items.title: Residence
items.description: Homes that keep the city at a distance while still belonging to it.
